description: >
  Rename a file and fix every link to it. Use when the user asks to move
  or rename a document that other documents link to.
---

# Rename a document

1. Run the search for links to the old path.
2. Rename the file.
3. Edit every link the search found.
4. Run the search again. Done when it finds no link to the old path.
